definitions.explanation: The money spent on staying at a hotel, inn, or other lodging facility.

examples.japanese: {宿泊費|しゅくはくひ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一泊|いっぱく}→一泊：08892_ippaku⟧{一万円|いちまんえん}だ。
examples.english: The accommodation cost is 10,000 yen per night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}→出張：01094_shucchou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{宿泊費|しゅくはくひ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The company covers the accommodation costs for business trips.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧のうち、{宿泊費|しゅくはくひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{割合|わりあい}→割合：01760_wariai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{占|し}めている→占める：11799_shimeru⟧。
examples.english: Among the travel budget items, accommodation costs make up the largest share.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{宿泊|しゅくはく}→宿泊：03216_shukuhaku⟧ (staying overnight; lodging) and ⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧ (expense; cost). A standard term used in both personal travel and business contexts. In business settings, {宿泊費|しゅくはくひ} is typically an itemized expense on travel reimbursement forms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {宿泊費|しゅくはくひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay accommodation costs
- {宿泊費|しゅくはくひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{節約|せつやく}する→節約する：25226_setsuyakusuru⟧: to save on accommodation costs
- {宿泊費|しゅくはくひ}⟦{込|こ}み→込み：28615_komi⟧: accommodation included
- {宿泊費|しゅくはくひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{精算|せいさん}→精算：10899_seisan⟧: settlement of lodging expenses

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{宿泊料|しゅくはくりょう}→宿泊料：07142_shukuhakuryou⟧: lodging fee — nearly identical; ⟦{料|りょう}→料：28172_ryou⟧ emphasizes the fee charged, while ⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧ emphasizes the cost incurred
- {滞在費|たいざいひ}: cost of stay — broader, covering all expenses during a stay (meals, transport, etc.)
